name: 相手の識別名で友だちを追加するフォーム
prompt:
Generate a single, front-on mobile UI screenshot matching the attached Japanese native preview at exactly 390 × 722 px. Use the native component preview as the primary source for layout, text and colors; use the original source crop only to confirm the structure and wording. Show the component alone on a flat white background, with no device frame, browser chrome, shadows, or extra UI.

Preserve the exact Japanese strings and their roles: 「誰に友だち申請を送りますか？」 at x=16,y=108,w=358,h=24 in Meiryo Regular 14 px, #1D1D1D; the rounded pale-mint input x=16,y=150,w=358,h=50 with 「相手の識別名を入力」 at x=32,y=163 in Meiryo Regular 14 px, #6E6E6E; the note 「あなたの識別名：やまだ・はるか」 at x=16,y=220 in Meiryo Regular 12 px, #6E6E6E; and the full-width dark-green rounded action x=16,y=670,w=358,h=32 with centered white 「友だち申請を送信」 in Meiryo Regular 12 px. Keep the large empty white area between the note and bottom action exactly as in the preview.

The note and username are neutral text, not a hyperlink in this native component: keep them gray and do not add an underline. If any actual hyperlink text is shown, color only that text blue #1976D2. Do not turn the placeholder, button label, headings, or other ordinary text blue. Keep the native green button; do not copy the source crop's disabled lavender button. Do not invent helper text, icons, borders, cards, examples, device frames, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the native form and colors, but the title is about 29px high, input/note about 34px high and bottom action about 25px high in the 390x722 comparison. The username note is native neutral gray (link=null); any actual hyperlink must be #1976D2.
